newsitem.title: USA: Texas Pacific Group to buy Del Monte Foods.
newsitem.headline: Texas Pacific Group to buy Del Monte Foods.

text.p: An investor group led by Texas Pacific Group said Friday it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire Del Monte Foods Co of San Francisco.
The Wall Street Journal, quoting "people familiar with the situation," reported today that the deal was worth at least $800 million, including the assumption of debt.
A Texas Pacific spokesman said Del Monte is owned by a group of entities including Merrill Lynch & Co, Citicorp and Kikkoman Corp.
Richard Wolford, a former president of Dole Packaged Foods Co, was named by Texas Pacific as chief executive of Del Monte.
Del Monte's current co-chief executive officers, Brian Haycox and Paul Mullan, will serve as consultants after the closing of the deal, which is expected within the next six weeks.
Other senior management is expected to remain with the San Francisco-based Del Monte, Texas Pacific said.
The acquisition includes all of Del Monte's packaged food products sold under its name in U.S. markets.
Del Monte had 1996 revenues of $1.2 billion, Texas Pacific said.
